explanation: OEIS A105210: 'This suggests that there may be infinitely many different (non-merging) sequences obtained by choosing different starting values.' The formal statement asks for an infinite set K of positive starting values whose orbits under n ↦ n + 1 + (sum of prime factors < n) are pairwise disjoint. That is a faithful rendering of 'infinitely many non-merging sequences'. Faithful.
